Basics Units Buildings Economy & Tech Controls

Getting Started

Command a medieval army: gather resources, raise a base, train troops, and destroy the enemy castle before they destroy yours.

The goal

Win by razing every enemy castle (Annihilation). Some matches instead use Economic victory (first to a resource total) or Timed victory (highest score when the clock runs out). Lose your last castle with no workers or castle-in-progress and you're out.

The loop

Gather → Build → Train → Fight. Right-click resources with workers to gather, build production from the sidebar, train an army, then right-click an enemy to attack. Scout first — you can only see what your units reveal.

First five minutes

Send every starting worker to gather. Build a House before you hit the population cap and a Barracks to unlock troops. Keep workers on gold — it pays for almost every soldier. Expand to a second resource cluster once your first is crowded (3 workers per node is the sweet spot).

The Healing Fountain

A neutral fountain stands near the center of every map — you don't build it, and no one owns it. Any unit standing close slowly regains health, so both armies want it and the middle becomes contested ground. It's the ideal spot to regroup and mend a battered army mid-fight.

Economy & Tech

The four resources

Gold — the army currency: nearly every soldier costs it. Scarce and contested.
Wood — buildings and siege. Renewable and plentiful.
Stone — defense and siege only (watchtowers and battering rams).
Food — labor: every unit needs it; farms produce it over time.

Gathering

Gold5/s per worker
Wood10/s per worker
Stone5/s per worker

A node supports 3 workers at full rate — pile on more and each gathers less, so spread out and expand.

The Market

Trade surplus for what you're short on — always at a loss, so it's a release valve, not a money press.

Sell 100 → 50 gold  ·  Buy 100 ← 150 gold

Controls & Strategy

Hotkeys

F1Select / cycle idle workers
F2Select all military buildings
HOMEJump camera to your castle
TABSelect + center next army unit
SCycle unit stance
FCycle group formation
GOpen / close selected gate
BSave camera bookmark
NJump between bookmarks
LToggle the event log
F5Quick save
F9Quick load
[Slow the game down
]Speed the game up
F6Toggle fog of war
Right-clickMove · gather · attack · build · garrison (context-aware)
Shift + Right-clickQueue commands
1–9Assign / recall control groups
EscPause menu

All keys are rebindable in keybindings.json.

Stances

Aggressive chases nearby enemies. Defensive fights back but stays near home. Stand Ground holds position and only hits what walks into range. No Attack never fights — good for scouts and fleeing workers. Cycle with the stance key.

Tactics

  • Counters: spearmen gut cavalry, cavalry run down archers, archers shred infantry, rams smash buildings (and die to any soldier).
  • Towers out-range archers — don't try to plink one down; bring a ram or overwhelm it.
  • Raid the undefended: forward mines and lumber camps are soft. Hit them before committing to the castle.
  • Garrison workers and troops in the castle or a tower to shelter them — each one inside a tower makes it fire faster.
  • Hold the fountain: the neutral healing fountain mends any unit nearby — great to regroup a wounded army on.
